changelog:
- Initial release of the "site-architecture" skill for website page hierarchy and navigation planning.
- Supports mapping site structures, navigation types, URL patterns, and internal linking practices.
- Provides templates and best practices for common site types (SaaS, e-commerce, content/blog, docs, etc.).
- Includes clear instructions for gathering business context and assessing current/future site needs.
- Explains ASCII and Mermaid formats for representing page hierarchies.
- Not intended for technical SEO audits or XML sitemap generation.
